tokens.name: desk
tokens.usage: The wooden desk the book rests on: app background outside the book. Text on it uses `desk-ink`.

tokens.name: desk-grain
tokens.usage: Wood grain strokes and the desk's shadowed edge.

tokens.name: desk-ink
tokens.usage: Small text and icons placed directly on `desk` (4.7:1 light, 13:1 dark).

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Parchment page: the main reading surface inside the book.

tokens.name: page-shade
tokens.usage: Gutter shading, inset wells, empty item slots and the page edge stack.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Raised paper: sticky notes, polaroids, inputs and cards laid on a page.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on `page`, `page-shade`, `paper` and every tint (10:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, placeholders on `page`, `page-shade`, `paper` (5.1:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Ruled-paper lines and quiet dividers. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: stroke
tokens.usage: Hand-drawn outlines on slots, buttons, chips and frames (5.2:1+ on page and paper).

tokens.name: fur
tokens.usage: Quokka fur brown: brand color for illustrations, ribbon bookmark and brand moments. Never body text.

tokens.name: marigold
tokens.usage: Primary action stamp (Check in, Save, Next). Text on it uses `on-marigold`.

tokens.name: marigold-press
tokens.usage: The stamped lower edge of marigold buttons and their pressed state.

tokens.name: on-marigold
tokens.usage: Label text on `marigold` (6.5:1 light, 8.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: blossom
tokens.usage: The quokka's flower. Care and support moments, the close tab, gentle alerts. Text on it uses `on-blossom`.

tokens.name: on-blossom
tokens.usage: Label text on `blossom` (5.3:1+).

tokens.name: petal
tokens.usage: Soft pink tint behind the support note and kind messages; text is `ink`.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Forecast blue: prediction lines, the selected slot ring, the forecast range band.

tokens.name: sky-tint
tokens.usage: Background behind forecasts and polaroid skies; text is `ink`.

tokens.name: sprout
tokens.usage: Learning and accuracy: the twin's progress, 'got it right' marks. Fills and marks only.

tokens.name: sprout-tint
tokens.usage: Background behind accuracy and insight notes; text is `ink`.

tokens.name: brick
tokens.usage: Form errors only (5.3:1 light, 4.9:1+ dark on page and paper). Never for low mood.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset (4.9:1+ on page and paper).

tokens.name: tape
tokens.usage: Washi tape that holds polaroids and notes to the page.

tokens.name: weather-1
tokens.usage: Feeling 1–2 · Rain. Calm slate blue, never alarming. Labels on it use `on-weather`.

tokens.name: weather-2
tokens.usage: Feeling 3–4 · Drizzle.

tokens.name: weather-3
tokens.usage: Feeling 5–6 · Cloudy.

tokens.name: weather-4
tokens.usage: Feeling 7–8 · Sunny.

tokens.name: weather-5
tokens.usage: Feeling 9–10 · Golden.

tokens.name: on-weather
tokens.usage: Text and numbers on any `weather-*` fill, both themes (5.2:1+).

styles.name: number-xl
styles.usage: Tomorrow's forecast number. Pair with `weather-*` fill.

styles.name: title-xl
styles.usage: Page title at the top of a chapter.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: You slept less than usual, so tomorrow may feel a little flatter.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Dates, axis labels, footnotes. Use tabular numbers.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: The quokka's voice and margin notes. Short phrases only.

styles.name: note-sm
styles.usage: Annotations on charts and polaroid captions.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, chip inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls; between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Item slot grid gap; button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; minimum side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page padding inside the book; space between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on a page.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Book margin on the desk at desktop widths.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips and small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Item slots, inputs, buttons, sticky notes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Book pages (outer corners) and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Feeling slider track and toggles.

shadow.note: Paper on paper: a hard 'thickness' edge plus a soft desk shadow. No glows.

tokens.name: shadow-paper
tokens.usage: Sticky notes, polaroids, cards laid on a page.

tokens.name: shadow-book
tokens.usage: The book on the desk: stacked page edges plus desk shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-stamp
tokens.usage: Raised edge under marigold buttons. Removed on press.

tokens.name: flip-duration
tokens.usage: One page turn. Reduced motion: 0ms (instant).

tokens.name: press-duration
tokens.usage: Button press-down.
